headline: L1 Capital initiates position in The Lottery Corporation, viewing it as a high-quality infrastructure-like asset with near-double-digit earnings growth and no major capex for 25 years

The simple way we think about TLC is that investors are getting a circa 3.5% fully frank dividend yield attached to a business that we believe can grow earnings at close to double digit rates over time, with very limited capital intensity and no major capex cycle expected for the next 25 years. In that sense, we see TLC as having some similarities to a transurban style infrastructure asset, defensive, long duration, regulated or licence protected earnings.
